	<!-- Sidewalls: only render above 1820px, where there's room for them -->
	<script data-cfasync="false" type="text/javascript">
		(function () {
			const SIDEWALLS = [ 'theanalyst-com_sidewall_right', 'theanalyst-com_sidewall_left' ];
			const MIN_WIDTH = 1820;
			let created = false;
			let deleted = false;

			function hasFreestar() {
				return typeof freestar !== 'undefined';
			}

			function createSidewalls() {
				if ( created || ! hasFreestar() || ! freestar.newSidewall ) {
					return;
				}
				if ( freestar.deleteSidewall ) {
					SIDEWALLS.forEach( function ( name ) { freestar.deleteSidewall( name ); } );
				}
				SIDEWALLS.forEach( function ( name ) { freestar.newSidewall( name ); } );
				created = true;
				deleted = false;
			}

			function deleteSidewalls() {
				if ( deleted || ! hasFreestar() || ! freestar.deleteSidewall ) {
					return;
				}
				SIDEWALLS.forEach( function ( name ) { freestar.deleteSidewall( name ); } );
				created = false;
				deleted = true;
			}

			function handleResize() {
				const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth;
				if ( viewportWidth <= MIN_WIDTH ) {
					deleteSidewalls();
				} else {
					createSidewalls();
				}
			}

			// Debounce resize so we don't thrash the ad slots on every event.
			let resizeTimer;
			function onResize() {
				clearTimeout( resizeTimer );
				resizeTimer = setTimeout( handleResize, 200 );
			}

			window.addEventListener( 'load', handleResize );
			window.addEventListener( 'resize', onResize );
		})();
	</script>
